text.p: State and Local Facilities Loan of 1997, Second Series NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received by the State of Maryland (the State'') for the purchase of the above described general obligation bonds (the
unless postponed, as described in the

The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997 and will bear interest payable on February 1, 1998 and semiannually thereafter on August 1 and February 1. The Bonds will mature on August 1, in the years 2000 through 2012, inclusive. The bonds will be issued in fully registered form in

denominations of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds maturing on or after August 1, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities on or after August 1, 2007. Each bid must be on the official bid form relating to the Bonds and conform to the terms and conditions set forth in the Official Notice of Sale.

This announcement does not constitute the solicitation of bids to purchase the Bonds. The sale of the Bonds shall be made exclusively pursuant to the terms of the Official Notice of Sale. Copies of the Official Notice of Sale, the official bid form relating to the Bonds and the Preliminary Official Statement will be furnished upon request made to the office of the State Treasurer, at the Louis L. Goldstein Treasury Building, Annapolis, Maryland 21401, telephone number (410) 974-3533 or Public Resources Advisory Group, Financial Advisor to the State, 40 Rector Street, Suite 1600, New York, New York 10006, telephone number (212) 566- 7800.
